prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency in Kansas City — the right agency depends on your goals, industry, budget, and the type of work you need (branding, digital advertising, web/UX, B2B demand gen, PR, etc.). 

A couple of widely recognized Kansas City agencies (to give you a starting point):
- Barkley — known for big-brand creative and branding work; strong in strategy and national ad campaigns.
- VML (Kansas City office) — global digital/experience agency; strong on digital transformation, UX, and integrated campaigns.

How I can help you find the best fit:
- Tell me: what are your goals (brand awareness, lead generation, e‑commerce growth), your industry, rough monthly/annual marketing budget, and what services you need (creative, paid media, SEO, web design, PR, social).  
- I’ll produce a short, tailored shortlist (3–6 agencies) with why each is a good match, sample case studies or clients, estimated costs, and questions to ask them in a discovery call.

If you’d prefer to look yourself first, check agency directories and review sites (Clutch, Ad Age Agency Report, Agency Spotter), review portfolios/case studies, and ask for client references and measurable results.
